CEO Jennifer Morgan (former SAP co-CEO, joined 2024) is openly transforming UKG into an 'AI-first company.' ~600 employees exited immediately; ~350 on transition through August 31. Notification by email April 15, 2026. Heavy hits to Sunrise and Weston, Florida offices. Second major cut in 18 months (2,200 cut in late 2024).

Cuts span Technology Modernization (consolidating to two hubs: Beaverton, OR and Nike India Technology Center), Air Manufacturing Modernization, and Materials Supply Chain Integration. TechCrunch headline: 'Cloudflare says AI made 1,100 jobs obsolete, even as revenue hit a record high.' Memo also said: 'We are making these changes now because making smaller, repeated cuts or dragging a reorganization out over multiple quarters creates prolonged emotional uncertainty for employees and stalls our ability to build.' Departing employees receive base pay through end of 2026. Restructuring cost $140-150M. Headcount was 5,483 as of March.

reasonGiven: Founder/CEO Zeb Evans on X: 'Today we reduced headcount by 22%. The business is the strongest it's ever been... the way to operate at the highest level of productivity is changing, and to win the future, ClickUp needs to change with it.' Restructuring around what Evans calls 'the 100x org' -- 100x output through AI. Key quotes: 'the great engineers, the ones who can orchestrate, architect, and review, are becoming 100x engineers. They're not writing code. They're directing agents that write code'; 'the bottlenecks are (1) orchestration -- telling AI what to do, and (2) reviewing -- what AI did. Everything is leapfrogged and no longer needed'; 'You must create enough disruption so that old systems are deprecated entirely. If there's any definition for AI native that's what it is.' Company now runs ~3,000 internal AI agents (3:1 agent-to-employee ratio per Fortune). Introducing $1 million cash/year salary bands. Severance packages provided. ClickUp valued at $4B in 2021.
